teaser: A full plan to build a custom Firefox for laptop and iPad with a governed agent hive, and why the part worth paying Mozilla for is keeping it working.
core_idea: A custom Firefox can be built with a Ruflo hive, an sgit vault and a behaviour policy by putting each want on the least invasive layer, policies, preferences, the browser's stylesheet and an extension, and only the rest in a renamed front-end patch set; the iPad needs a fork of the separate WebKit codebase; with releases every two weeks the real cost is maintenance on two codebases, which is what Mozilla, already selling a branded build and custom development to organisations, should sell to one person, per release or per change.
